title: Getting Around Madeira: Car, Bus, Taxi or Boat?
description: Getting around Madeira without stress: when to rent a car, how buses, taxis and ride apps work, and why a private boat is the easiest way to see the coast.
heroAlt: Aerial view of the pier at Ponta do Sol, Madeira
keywords: do you need a car in Madeira
